newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gunmen stage French Riviera hold up.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen stage French Riviera hold up.

text.p: Hooded gunmen held up an armoured van carrying the day takings of several French Riviera supermarkets and made off with up to 10 million francs ($1.7 million) without firing a shot, police sources said on Friday.

The attack, carried out with military precision, took place on Thursday evening near Nice. The gunmen, some of whom wielded rocket launchers, fled after forcing the security guards to open the van and loading cash bags into three cars.
